_meta.description: Official AI lab release and model-documentation source index. This file tracks where to review frontier and foundation-model announcements; it does not rank models or store live release state.
_meta.scopeNote: Static reference only. CloudIntelMatrix links to official lab sources for model docs, release notes, and safety context without fetching, ranking, or summarizing live AI news at runtime.

sources.name: OpenAI

modelDetails.name: GPT-5.5
modelDetails.bestFor: Flagship frontier work requiring complex reasoning, coding, professional output, tools, and long context.
modelDetails.sourceNote: OpenAI positions GPT-5.5 as its flagship model for complex reasoning and coding, and describes it as a new class of intelligence for coding and professional work.

modelDetails.name: GPT-5.5 Pro
modelDetails.bestFor: Higher-precision GPT-5.5 work where response quality matters more than cost or latency.
modelDetails.sourceNote: OpenAI describes GPT-5.5 Pro as a version of GPT-5.5 that produces smarter and more precise responses.

modelDetails.name: GPT-5.4
modelDetails.bestFor: More affordable coding and professional-work tasks that still need frontier-class capability.
modelDetails.sourceNote: OpenAI describes GPT-5.4 as a more affordable model for coding and professional work.

modelDetails.name: GPT-5.4 Pro
modelDetails.bestFor: Higher-precision GPT-5.4 workloads where answer quality is prioritized over cost.
modelDetails.sourceNote: OpenAI describes GPT-5.4 Pro as a version of GPT-5.4 that produces smarter and more precise responses.

modelDetails.name: GPT-5.4 mini
modelDetails.bestFor: Lower-latency and lower-cost coding, computer-use, and subagent workloads.
modelDetails.sourceNote: OpenAI calls GPT-5.4 mini its strongest mini model yet for coding, computer use, and subagents.

modelDetails.name: GPT-5.4 nano
modelDetails.bestFor: Simple high-volume tasks where low cost and low latency matter most.
modelDetails.sourceNote: OpenAI describes GPT-5.4 nano as its cheapest GPT-5.4-class model for simple high-volume tasks.

modelDetails.name: GPT Image 2
modelDetails.bestFor: Image generation and editing workflows.
modelDetails.sourceNote: OpenAI lists GPT Image 2 under image generation and editing and describes it as a state-of-the-art image generation model.

modelDetails.name: GPT-Realtime-2
modelDetails.bestFor: Realtime voice interaction workflows that need reasoning.
modelDetails.sourceNote: OpenAI lists GPT-Realtime-2 under realtime, speech, and audio workflows and describes it as a reasoning model for realtime voice interactions.

sources.summary: Official OpenAI surfaces for model availability, product releases, API model documentation, and safety context.

sources.name: Anthropic

modelDetails.name: Claude Fable 5
modelDetails.bestFor: Highest-capability general Claude work and long-running agent tasks.
modelDetails.sourceNote: Anthropic describes Claude Fable 5 as its most capable widely released model and lists it for next-generation intelligence on long-running agents.

modelDetails.name: Claude Opus 4.8
modelDetails.bestFor: Complex agentic coding and enterprise work.
modelDetails.sourceNote: Anthropic's model overview describes Claude Opus 4.8 as suited for complex agentic coding and enterprise work.

modelDetails.name: Claude Sonnet 5
modelDetails.bestFor: Balanced speed and intelligence for coding, agents, and professional work.
modelDetails.sourceNote: Anthropic's model overview describes Claude Sonnet 5 as the best combination of speed and intelligence; the release note positions it for coding, agents, and professional work at scale.

modelDetails.name: Claude Haiku 4.5
modelDetails.bestFor: Fast near-frontier responses, responsive subagent work, and cost-sensitive Claude workflows.
modelDetails.sourceNote: Anthropic's model overview describes Claude Haiku 4.5 as the fastest model with near-frontier intelligence.

modelDetails.name: Claude Mythos 5
modelDetails.bestFor: Approved defensive cybersecurity workflows where Anthropic grants limited access.
modelDetails.sourceNote: Anthropic says Claude Mythos 5 is offered for defensive cybersecurity workflows through Project Glasswing and is not generally available.

modelDetails.name: Claude Mythos Preview
modelDetails.bestFor: Invitation-only defensive cybersecurity evaluation and Project Glasswing workflows.
modelDetails.sourceNote: Anthropic identifies Claude Mythos Preview as part of Project Glasswing with invitation-only access.

sources.summary: Official Anthropic sources for Claude model documentation, product announcements, and responsible-scaling policy context.

sources.name: Google Gemini

modelDetails.name: Gemini 3.5 Flash
modelDetails.bestFor: Sustained frontier performance on agentic and coding tasks.
modelDetails.sourceNote: Google's Gemini API docs list Gemini 3.5 Flash as stable and describe it as the most intelligent model for sustained frontier performance on agentic and coding tasks.

modelDetails.name: Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite
modelDetails.bestFor: Cost-sensitive workloads that need frontier-class performance at smaller-model economics.
modelDetails.sourceNote: Google's Gemini API docs describe Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite as stable and frontier-class at a fraction of the cost.

modelDetails.name: Gemini 3.1 Pro
modelDetails.bestFor: Advanced intelligence, complex problem solving, agentic work, and vibe coding in preview.
modelDetails.sourceNote: Google's Gemini API docs list Gemini 3.1 Pro as preview and describe advanced intelligence, complex problem-solving, and powerful agentic and vibe coding capabilities.

modelDetails.name: Gemini 3 Flash
modelDetails.bestFor: Preview Flash workloads needing frontier-class performance at lower cost.
modelDetails.sourceNote: Google's Gemini API docs list Gemini 3 Flash as preview and describe frontier-class performance at a fraction of the cost.

modelDetails.name: Gemini 2.5 Pro
modelDetails.bestFor: Complex tasks requiring deep reasoning and coding capability.
modelDetails.sourceNote: Google's Gemini API docs describe Gemini 2.5 Pro as its most advanced model for complex tasks, with deep reasoning and coding capabilities.

modelDetails.name: Nano Banana 2
modelDetails.bestFor: High-efficiency image generation and editing optimized for speed and high-volume use.
modelDetails.sourceNote: Google's Gemini API docs list Nano Banana 2 as stable and describe powerful, high-efficiency image generation and editing optimized for speed and high-volume use cases.

sources.summary: Official Google Gemini sources for model docs, Gemini API changes, and product announcements.

sources.name: xAI

modelDetails.name: Grok 4.3
modelDetails.bestFor: General xAI chat and agentic work; xAI says to use it for everything except dedicated audio, image, and video APIs.
modelDetails.sourceNote: xAI describes Grok 4.3 as supporting agentic tool calling and recommends it for general use outside dedicated media APIs.

modelDetails.name: Grok Build 0.1
modelDetails.bestFor: Fast coding workflows trained for agentic coding.
modelDetails.sourceNote: xAI describes Grok Build 0.1 as a fast coding model trained specifically for agentic coding workflows.

modelDetails.name: Grok Imagine API
modelDetails.bestFor: Image and video generation and editing.
modelDetails.sourceNote: xAI describes Imagine API as turning ideas into image and video generation, with generation and editing modes.

modelDetails.name: Grok Voice API
modelDetails.bestFor: Realtime conversations, speech-to-text, and text-to-speech workloads.
modelDetails.sourceNote: xAI lists Voice API for real-time conversations, speech-to-text, and text-to-speech.

sources.summary: Official xAI surfaces for Grok model documentation, developer release notes, news, and safety context.

sources.name: DeepSeek

modelDetails.name: deepseek-v4-flash
modelDetails.bestFor: Lower-cost DeepSeek API workloads needing both thinking and non-thinking modes, JSON output, tool calls, and long context.
modelDetails.sourceNote: DeepSeek's model table lists v4-flash with thinking and non-thinking modes, 1M context, JSON output, tool calls, and lower listed token pricing than v4-pro.

modelDetails.name: deepseek-v4-pro
modelDetails.bestFor: DeepSeek API workloads that prefer the Pro variant while retaining thinking and non-thinking modes, JSON output, tool calls, and long context.
modelDetails.sourceNote: DeepSeek's model table lists v4-pro with thinking and non-thinking modes, 1M context, JSON output, and tool calls.

modelDetails.name: deepseek-chat
modelDetails.bestFor: Legacy non-thinking compatibility only; plan migration before the documented deprecation date.
modelDetails.sourceNote: DeepSeek says deepseek-chat is deprecated on 2026-07-24 and maps to the non-thinking mode of deepseek-v4-flash for compatibility.

modelDetails.name: deepseek-reasoner
modelDetails.bestFor: Legacy thinking-mode compatibility only; plan migration before the documented deprecation date.
modelDetails.sourceNote: DeepSeek says deepseek-reasoner is deprecated on 2026-07-24 and maps to the thinking mode of deepseek-v4-flash for compatibility.

sources.summary: Official DeepSeek API documentation and update log for model and platform release review.

sources.name: Stability AI
sources.modelFamily: Stable image, audio, video, and 3D models

modelDetails.name: Stable Audio 3.0
modelDetails.bestFor: Generative music and audio workflows, including longer variable-length generation and portable full-song composition.
modelDetails.sourceNote: Stability AI describes Stable Audio 3.0 as a fully licensed open-weight music model family with variable-length generation up to six minutes and full song composition on portable devices.

modelDetails.name: Stable Image Ultra
modelDetails.bestFor: Photorealistic, high-quality text-to-image generation for large-scale visual output.
modelDetails.sourceNote: Stability AI describes Stable Image Ultra as one of its most advanced text-to-image models, suited to photorealistic, large-scale output.

modelDetails.name: Stable Diffusion 3.5
modelDetails.bestFor: Customizable image-generation workflows that need open model variants and consumer-hardware deployment options.
modelDetails.sourceNote: Stability AI describes Stable Diffusion 3.5 as an open release with multiple variants that are highly customizable for their size and can run on consumer hardware.

modelDetails.name: Stable Video 4D 2.0
modelDetails.bestFor: Single-video-to-4D and novel-view synthesis workflows.
modelDetails.sourceNote: Stability AI says Stable Video 4D 2.0 upgrades SV4D for higher-quality real-world video outputs and state-of-the-art 4D generation and novel-view synthesis.

sources.summary: Official Stability AI sources for generative media model announcements, platform docs, and release notes.
